sloka: स देवलोकस्य तमो निहत्य सूर्यो यथा राहुमुखाद्विमुक्तः।तथा व्यभासीद्भुवि वानरौघे निहत्य रामो युधि कुम्भकर्णम् ।। ६.६७.१६५ ।।
transliteration: sa devalokasya tamo nihatya sūryo yathā rāhumukhādvimuktaḥ।tathā vyabhāsīdbhuvi vānaraughe nihatya rāmo yudhi kumbhakarṇam ।। 6.67.165 ।।

translations.english: Both the feet falling on ground made a resounding noise that filled all over the four quarters, all directions, nay all mountains and caves of Trikuta and also Lanka.
